title: Odoo Development
tagline: Build and extend Odoo modules using models, fields, business logic, XML views, actions, integrations, and debugging.
description: Odoo development connects business requirements with maintainable modules, interfaces, logic, and integrations. Strong developers understand both the framework and the operational reason behind every customization.
This broad technical track covers the complete module-development workflow and prepares learners to build, extend, troubleshoot, and support Odoo solutions in realistic projects.
learningOutcomes: Understand Odoo architecture and module structure
Create models, fields, relationships, and business logic
Customize interfaces, navigation, actions, and workflows
Build and extend maintainable custom modules
Integrate, debug, document, and support technical solutions
whoItsFor: Python developers applying programming skills within a business-focused ERP framework
Technical learners specializing in Odoo architecture, modules, and customization
ERP technical support moving from troubleshooting into structured development work
Project developers preparing for custom modules, enhancements, and integration assignments
requirements: Basic XML, HTML, and web-development concepts
Understanding of relational data and business workflows
Comfort using Git and a development environment is recommended

curriculum.title: Odoo Architecture
curriculum.description: Understand architecture, addons, manifests, module structure, environments, and development flow.

curriculum.title: Module Structure, Models, and Fields
curriculum.description: Define models, relationships, computed values, constraints, and business rules.

curriculum.title: Business Logic and XML Views
curriculum.description: Build and inherit form, list, search, kanban, and other user-interface views.

curriculum.title: Actions and Menus
curriculum.description: Organize navigation and connect user actions to business behavior.

curriculum.title: Custom Modules
curriculum.description: Build a maintainable module from requirement analysis through packaging and installation.

curriculum.title: Integrations
curriculum.description: Connect Odoo with APIs and external tools while preserving reliable structure.

curriculum.title: Debugging and Maintenance
curriculum.description: Troubleshoot issues, improve code quality, manage upgrades, and support stable deployments.

curriculum.title: Capstone Development Scenario
curriculum.description: Design, build, test, document, and present a custom Odoo business solution.

projects.title: Custom Business Module
projects.description: Build models, security, menus, actions, and views for a realistic requirement.

projects.title: Workflow Extension
projects.description: Extend an existing Odoo process with new validations, fields, and controlled behavior.

projects.title: External Integration
projects.description: Connect Odoo to a third-party service through a documented API workflow.

faq.question: How is this different from Python Development for Odoo?
faq.answer: Odoo Development is the broader end-to-end framework track — architecture, modules, views, actions, and integrations. Python Development for Odoo goes deeper into Python, the ORM, and advanced backend implementation patterns specifically.

faq.question: Do I need advanced Python?
faq.answer: You should be comfortable with Python fundamentals. Learners needing stronger Python and ORM depth may benefit more from the Python Development for Odoo track.

faq.question: Will I build a complete module?
faq.answer: Yes. The curriculum includes custom module work and a capstone business solution.

faq.question: Are integrations included?
faq.answer: Yes. The course introduces external connections, API workflows, and technical enhancement patterns.

instructor.name: Ibrahim
